## Summary

I implemented VeLoRA (Memory Efficient Training using Rank-1 Sub-Token Projections) as a LoRA variant in the PEFT library. VeLoRA reduces peak GPU memory by compressing the input activations cached for the backward pass instead of storing the full input.

### Files changed

**`src/peft/tuners/lora/velora.py`** (new module) — the low-level primitives:
- `_reshape_to_grouped_subtokens(x, num_groups)` — flattens leading dims, zero-pads the feature dim to a multiple of `num_groups`, reshapes to `(N, num_groups, ceil(in_features/num_groups))`.
- `_normalize_projection(embed)` — L2-normalizes the projection vector.
- `_compress_activations(x, embed, num_groups)` — projects grouped sub-tokens onto `embed` → `(N, num_groups)`.
- `_reconstruct_activations(compressed, embed, in_features, velora_scale)` — outer product + truncate to `in_features`, scaled → `(N, in_features)`.
- `VeloraFunction` — `torch.autograd.Function` whose forward returns `F.linear(x, weight, bias)` but saves only the *compressed* activations; backward computes `grad_input = grad_output @ weight`, `grad_weight` from reconstructed `X_hat`, and `grad_bias` as the batch sum.

**`src/peft/tuners/lora/config.py`**:
- Added the `VeloraConfig` dataclass (`num_groups=64`, `scale=1.0`, `init_type='batch_average'`) with the exact required `ValueError` messages.
- Added the optional `velora_config` field to `LoraConfig`, with dict→`VeloraConfig` normalization in `__post_init__`.

**`src/peft/tuners/lora/variants.py`** — added `VeloraLinearVariant`:
- Registers `lora_velora_embed` (a non-persistent `BufferDict`, shape `(ceil(in_features/num_groups),)`) and `lora_velora_initialized` (dict of bool) per adapter.
- `random` → normalized random embed, initialized `True`; `batch_average_once` → computed from the first training batch then frozen; `batch_average` → recomputed every training forward.
- Forward routes `lora_A` through `VeloraFunction`; `merge`/`unmerge` reuse the standard LoRA delta.

**`src/peft/tuners/lora/layer.py`** — `Linear.resolve_lora_variant` returns `VeloraLinearVariant` when `velora_config` is set.

**`__init__.py`** (lora, tuners, top-level peft) — export `VeloraConfig` as the same class object at all import paths.
